top_choice_rationale: P001 (Drucker, Holst, Knudsen) credits the full arc from GLP-1 and incretin physiology to long-acting analogues with randomized glycaemic, weight, cardiovascular and renal outcome data; the science is mature and independently confirmed. The citation names both physiology and its development into therapy, and each name rests on a documented contribution. Mojsov's priority relative to the Habener group cannot be verified from the supplied record, and P002 would cite incretin treatment without crediting the developer of the drugs. P002 is a defensible discovery-centred second choice, and any award is preferable to none given the maturity of this achievement.
